author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for illustrators: participation and democracy stickers
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. We are open to different styles and want to give the selected illustrator plenty of creative freedom to bring their own ideas and artistic identity to the collection. 🌍 Open to illustrators worldwide 💶 Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment 🎨 Approximately 10–15 original illustrations 📅 Application deadline: 8 November 2026 ✅ Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026 🚫 Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. A simple sketch, rough concept, or mood board is enough. We do not expect substantial unpaid creative work. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio. Know an illustrator whose work could bring a fresh perspective to participation? Share this call with them!

author: NIN Creative Studio

author: The Dzinrz Illustration Studio
title: We're Hiring Illustrators
content: WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS! Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work! At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects. Who can apply? Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. We value talent, creativity, and the willingness to grow! Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations. How to apply: Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com Visit www.thedzinrz.com to explore our portfolio.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST
